turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey! How's it going?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Pretty good. How about you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Can't complain. Just been busy with work.
turns.zh: 还行，就是最近工作有点忙。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I hear you. Same here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: What have you been up to lately?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Not much. Just working and hanging out.
turns.zh: 没什么，就是上班、和朋友聚聚。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Anything fun planned for the weekend?
turns.zh: 周末有什么好玩的安排吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Not yet. Got any ideas?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: You wanna grab coffee later?
turns.zh: 待会儿要不要去喝杯咖啡？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm down. What time?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How about around three?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Works for me. See you then.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Wanna come over tonight?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks, but I'm gonna sit this one out.
turns.zh: 谢谢，不过这次我就不去了。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: No worries. Everything okay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, I'm just wiped out. Rain check?
turns.zh: 没事，就是累坏了。改天好吗？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, where are you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm on my way, but I'm running a bit late.
turns.zh: 我在路上，不过可能会晚一点。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: No rush. How far out are you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: About ten minutes. My bad!
turns.zh: 大概十分钟，不好意思啊！

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: We can just play it by ear.
turns.zh: 我们到时候看情况再定。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sorry, what does 'play it by ear' mean?
turns.zh: 不好意思，play it by ear 是什么意思？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: It means we don't have to decide right now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oh, got it. Thanks!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Could you fill out this form and bring it back?
turns.zh: 你能填好这张表再拿回来吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sorry, could you say that a little more slowly?
turns.zh: 不好意思，你能说慢一点吗？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure. Fill out this form, then bring it back here.
turns.zh: 当然。填好这张表，然后拿回这里。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Got it. Thank you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: What do you think of this place?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Honestly, I love the vibe.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Same! The coffee's pretty good, too.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: We should come back sometime.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: What are you in the mood for?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm good with anything. You pick.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How about Thai food?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sounds good to me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi! What can I get started for you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Can I get an iced latte with oat milk?
turns.zh: 请给我一杯燕麦奶冰拿铁。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure. What size?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Medium, please. That's all.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Iced latte for Alex!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That's me. Thanks!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Of course. Have a good one!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: You too!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, table for two?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes. How long is the wait?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: About fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: That's fine. Could you put us on the list?
turns.zh: 没问题，麻烦帮我们排一下队。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Are you ready to order?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Almost. What's your favorite thing here?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: The grilled salmon is really popular.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'll go with that, then.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How was everything?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Really good, thanks. Could we get the check?
turns.zh: 很好吃，谢谢。可以结账吗？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Of course. Together or separate?
turns.zh: 当然。一起付还是分开付？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Separate, please.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, did the food arrive?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, but they forgot my drink.
turns.zh: 到了，但他们漏了我的饮料。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: That's annoying. Did you contact support?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Not yet. I'll do it now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Excuse me, where can I find eggs?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Aisle five, near the milk.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Awesome, thanks!

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No problem!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How's everything fitting?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's a little tight. Do you have a size up?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Let me check in the back.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks, I appreciate it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Excuse me, is the station far from here?
turns.zh: 打扰一下，车站离这里远吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Not really. It's about a ten-minute walk.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Great. Am I heading the right way?
turns.zh: 太好了。我走的方向对吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yep. Just keep going straight.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, are you here for Alex?
turns.zh: 你好，你是来接亚历克斯的吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yep. Heading to the airport?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: That's right. Could you pop the trunk?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure thing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi there. Checking in?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yes, I have a reservation under Chen.
turns.zh: 对，我用陈这个名字订了房。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Great. Can I see your ID?
turns.zh: 好的，可以看一下证件吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure, here you go.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, we just got here. How do we get in?
turns.zh: 你好，我们刚到。怎么进门？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: There's a keypad next to the door.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Got it. Is the code in the message?
turns.zh: 明白了。密码在消息里吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yep! Let me know if you have trouble.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Are you checking any bags today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Just this one suitcase.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Any liquids or batteries inside?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No batteries. Just clothes and toiletries.
turns.zh: 没有电池，只有衣服和洗漱用品。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Would you like something to drink?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Could I have an orange juice, please?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure. Anything else?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No, that's it. Thank you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, I'm Jamie. What's your name?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm Alex. Nice to meet you.
turns.zh: 我叫亚历克斯，很高兴认识你。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Nice to meet you, too. Are you from around here?
turns.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你是本地人吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No, I'm just visiting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, do you have a sec?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure, what's up?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Could you take a look at this design?
turns.zh: 能帮我看一下这个设计吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, send it over.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Are we still on for two?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yep, two works for me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Great. I'll send the link.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Perfect, thanks.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, you're breaking up.
turns.zh: 嘿，你的声音断断续续的。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sorry, my Wi-Fi's acting up.
turns.zh: 抱歉，我的无线网络不太稳定。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: No worries. Wanna turn off your camera?
turns.zh: 没事，要不先关掉摄像头？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Good idea. Is that better?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I think we should keep it simple.
turns.zh: 我觉得我们应该保持简单。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Totally. Less is more.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: So let's cut the extra stuff.
turns.zh: 那我们把多余的内容删掉。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sounds like a plan.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I think we should launch tomorrow.
turns.zh: 我觉得我们明天就该上线。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm not so sure about that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: What's your concern?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: We might need another round of testing.
turns.zh: 我们可能还需要再测试一轮。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, I think you took my seat.
turns.zh: 嘿，我想你坐了我的位子。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oh, my bad! I didn't realize.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: No big deal.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Thanks for being cool about it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, you good?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, just a little stressed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Wanna talk about it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Maybe later. Thanks for asking.
turns.zh: 可能晚点吧，谢谢你关心。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, can I borrow your charger?
turns.zh: 嘿，能借一下你的充电器吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, go for it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Thanks. I'll give it right back.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: No rush.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Should we go now or wait a bit?
turns.zh: 我们现在走还是等一会儿？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's up to you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Let's head out now, then.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Cool, let's go.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Looks like it's gonna rain.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Should we call it off?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Let's just move it indoors.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Works for me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I think I lost my wallet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Oh no. Where did you last see it?
turns.zh: 天啊。你最后一次在哪里见到它？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Maybe at the café.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Let's call them and ask.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, can I ask you a question?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Of course. What can I help you with?

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: I've had a headache since this morning.
turns.zh: 我从早上开始一直头疼。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Are you taking any other medications?
turns.zh: 你还在服用其他药物吗？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hi, my package says delivered, but I can't find it.
turns.zh: 你好，物流显示包裹送到了，但我找不到。

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I'm sorry about that. Can I have your tracking number?
turns.zh: 很抱歉。能提供运单号吗？

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Sure, let me pull it up.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Take your time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How do you pronounce this word?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: It's pronounced 'comfortable'.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Can you say it one more time?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Sure. Comfortable.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Anyway, I should get going.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah, it was great catching up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Let's do this again soon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: For sure. Take care!

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Hey, did you get my text?
turns.zh: 嘿，你收到我发的消息了吗？

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yep, just saw it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Can you make it tonight?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I think so. I'll let you know.
